question_uz: IDS (Intrusion Detection System) va IPS (Intrusion Prevention System) o'rtasidagi asosiy prinsipial farq nima?
question_en: What is the fundamental difference between an IDS and an IPS?
options_uz: IDS apparat qurilma, IPS faqat brauzer kengaytmasi
IDS faqat parollarni tekshiradi, IPS esa faqat e-maillarni skanerlaydi
IDS faqat shubhali trafikni aniqlaydi va ogohlantiradi (passiv), IPS esa aniqlash bilan birga zararli trafikni avtomatik bloklaydi (faol)
Hech qanday farqi yo'q, ikkalasi bir xil narsaning sinonimi
options_en: IDS is hardware, IPS is browser extension
IDS only checks passwords, IPS scans emails
IDS detects and alerts; IPS actively blocks malicious traffic
hint: D — Detection (aniqlash), P — Prevention (oldini olish/to'xtatish).
why_right: IDS passiv kuzatuvchi bo'lib ogohlantirish (alert) beradi. IPS esa tarmoq oqimida (in-line) turib zararli paketlarni darhol tashlab yuboradi (drop).
why_right_en: Correct answer: «IDS detects and alerts; IPS actively blocks malicious traffic».

why_wrongs.A: Noto'g'ri: 'IDS apparat qurilma, IPS faqat brauzer kengaytmasi' ushbu savol shartiga mos kelmaydi yoki boshqa tushunchaga tegishli.

question_uz: Veb-ilovalardagi xavfsizlik kamchiliklari va xatolarini tahlil qiluvchi 'Zaiflik' (Vulnerability) va ushbu zaiflikdan foydalanib tizimni buzuvchi kod/vosita 'Exploit' o'rtasidagi munosabat qanday?
question_en: What is the precise relationship between a 'Vulnerability' and an 'Exploit' in application security?
options_uz: Ikkalasi mutlaqo bir xil ma'noni beradi
Zaiflik — bu antivirus dasturi, Exploit esa operatsion tizim
Exploit — bu tizimni himoya qiluvchi xavfsizlik devori
Zaiflik — bu koddagi teshik/nuqson; Exploit esa ushbu teshikdan foydalanib noqonuniy kirish yoki zarar yetkazish uchun yozilgan dasturiy kod
options_en: Vulnerability is antivirus, exploit is OS
Vulnerability is the flaw; Exploit is the software weapon taking advantage of it
hint: Qulfdagi nosozlik — zaiflik, o'sha nosozlikni ochadigan egilgan sim — exploit.
why_right: Zaiflik mavjud bo'lishi mumkin, lekin unga mos exploit bo'lmasa, tizimni osonlikcha buzib bo'lmaydi. Exploit zaiflikni amalda ishlatuvchi quroldir.
why_right_en: Correct answer: «Vulnerability is the flaw; Exploit is the software weapon taking advantage of it».

question_uz: Tarixiy 'Sezar shifri' (Caesar Cipher) qanday shifrlash usuliga mansub?

options_uz: Almashtirish (Monoalphabetic Substitution) shifriga: har bir harf alifboda ma'lum bir siljish (shift) qadamiga suriladi
options_en: Monoalphabetic substitution: each letter is shifted by a fixed number of positions
hint: Harflar o'z o'rnida turadi, faqat alifbo bo'yicha 3 ta harf oldinga yoki orqaga almashtiriladi.
why_right: Sezar shifri eng qadimgi simmetrik almashtirish shifri bo'lib, unda harflar chastotali tahlil (frequency analysis) yoki bor-yo'g'i 25 ta siljishni tekshirish orqali oson buziladi.
why_right_en: Correct answer: «Monoalphabetic substitution: each letter is shifted by a fixed number of positions».

question_uz: Sezar shifri bilan shifrlangan 'KHOOR' so'zini K = 3 kaliti bilan deshifrlaganda (teskari siljitganda) qaysi so'z hosil bo'ladi?
question_en: Deciphering the ciphertext 'KHOOR' using Caesar cipher with key K = 3 yields which plaintext word?
hint: Harflarni alifboda 3 ta orqaga suring: K - 3 = H; H - 3 = E; O - 3 = L; O - 3 = L; R - 3 = O.
why_right: K->H, H->E, O->L, O->L, R->O. Natija: HELLO.

question_uz: Ochiq kalitlar infratuzilmasida (PKI - Public Key Infrastructure) Raqamli Sertifikatlar (Digital Certificates) nima vazifani bajaradi?
question_en: What essential role do Digital Certificates fulfill within a Public Key Infrastructure (PKI)?
options_uz: Foydalanuvchi yoki veb-saytning ochiq kalitini uning haqiqiy shaxsi bilan ishonchli bog'laydi va buni Sertifikat Markazi (CA) imzosi bilan tasdiqlaydi

why_right: Raqamli sertifikat (X.509 standarti) orqali biz ulanayotgan sayt haqiqatan ham 'google.com' ekanligiga va xaker soxta kalit bermayotganiga ishonch hosil qilamiz.
why_right_en: Correct answer: «Binds a public key to an entity's verified identity, digitally signed by a trusted CA».

question_uz: Simmetrik shifrlashda 'Block Cipher' (Blokli shifr) va 'Stream Cipher' (Oqimli shifr) o'rtasidagi asosiy farq nimada?
question_en: What differentiates a Block Cipher from a Stream Cipher in symmetric encryption?
options_uz: Blokli shifr ma'lumotlarni qat'iy o'lchamdagi guruhlarga (masalan, 128 bitli bloklarga) bo'lib shifrlaydi; Oqimli shifr esa ma'lumotni bitma-bit (yoki baytma-bayt) ketma-ket shifrlaydi
Blokli shifr faqat matnni, oqimli shifr esa faqat videoni shifrlaydi
Oqimli shifrda hech qachon kalit bo'lmaydi
options_en: Block ciphers encrypt fixed blocks (e.g., 128-bit); Stream ciphers encrypt bit-by-bit continuously
Block for text, stream for video only
hint: AES — blokli shifr, ChaCha20 yoki RC4 — oqimli shifr hisoblanadi.
why_right: Blokli shifrlar qat'iy bloklar bilan ishlaydi (agar matn yetmasa, padding qo'shiladi); Oqimli shifrlar esa real vaqtda oqayotgan audio/video trafigi uchun juda tez va qulaydir.
why_right_en: Correct answer: «Block ciphers encrypt fixed blocks (e.g., 128-bit); Stream ciphers encrypt bit-by-bit continuously».

why_wrongs.B: Noto'g'ri: 'Blokli shifr faqat matnni, oqimli shifr esa faqat videoni shifrlaydi' ushbu savol shartiga mos kelmaydi yoki boshqa tushunchaga tegishli.

question_uz: TLS (Transport Layer Security) qo'l berib ko'rishish (Handshake) jarayonida asimmetrik va simmetrik kriptografiya qanday birgalikda (gibrid) qo'llaniladi?
question_en: How do asymmetric and symmetric encryption synergize in a TLS handshake?
options_uz: Faqat asimmetrik shifrlash ishlatiladi, simmetrik umuman ishlatilmaydi
Dastlab asimmetrik shifrlash (RSA/ECC) orqali seans kaliti xavfsiz almashib olinadi, so'ngra asosiy katta ma'lumotlar oqimi tezkor simmetrik shifr (AES) bilan uzatiladi

options_en: Asymmetric crypto exchanges a session key securely, then high-speed symmetric crypto (AES) encrypts session traffic
hint: Asimmetrik — xavfsiz lekin sekin; Simmetrik — juda tez lekin kalitni yetkazish kerak. Ikkalasi birlashtirilsa ideal tizim chiqadi.
why_right: Gibrid kriptotizim: Asimmetrik shifrlash kalit tarqatish muammosini hal qiladi, simmetrik shifrlash esa internetdagi gigabaytlab ma'lumotni maksimal tezlikda himoyalaydi.
why_right_en: Correct answer: «Asymmetric crypto exchanges a session key securely, then high-speed symmetric crypto (AES) encrypts session traffic».

question_en: Which access control model assigns system permissions based on organizational job functions and responsibilities?
options_uz: RBAC (Role-Based Access Control / Rollarga asoslangan kirish)

question_uz: Active-Active va Active-Passive klaster konfiguratsiyalari o'rtasidagi asosiy farq qaysi?
question_en: What is the operational difference between Active-Active and Active-Passive cluster configurations?
options_uz: Active-Passive da ikkinchi server hech qachon ishlamaydi
Active-Active rejimida barcha serverlar bir vaqtda yuklamani (trafikni) qabul qiladi; Active-Passive da esa faqat bitta server ishlaydi, ikkinchisi kutish (standby) rejimida turadi
options_en: In Active-Active all nodes actively process load simultaneously; in Active-Passive standby nodes wait until failure
hint: Active-Active — barcha tugunlar faol; Active-Passive — biri faol, ikkinchisi zaxirada.
why_right: Active-Active tizimlar Load Balancer yordamida yuklamani teng taqsimlaydi va maksimal unumdorlik beradi. Active-Passive esa oddiyroq va ma'lumotlar sinxronizatsiyasi osonroq.
why_right_en: Correct answer: «In Active-Active all nodes actively process load simultaneously; in Active-Passive standby nodes wait until failure».

why_wrongs.C: Noto'g'ri: 'Hech qanday farqi yo'q' ushbu savol shartiga mos kelmaydi yoki boshqa tushunchaga tegishli.

question_uz: Favqulodda vaziyatlarda 'RPO' (Recovery Point Objective / Tiklanish nuqtasi maqsadi) ko'rsatkichi nimani bildiradi?

options_uz: Falokat yuz berganda tashkilot qabul qila oladigan maksimal ma'lumot yo'qotilishi vaqti (oxirgi zaxira nusxasidan beri o'tgan vaqt)
Serverni ta'mirlash uchun ketadigan soatlar soni

hint: Point — vaqtdagi nuqta: qancha vaqtlik ma'lumot yo'qolishiga chidashimiz mumkin?
why_right: Agar zaxira nusxa (backup) har kecha soat 00:00 da olinsa va avariya kunduzi 18:00 da yuz bersa, 18 soatlik ma'lumot yo'qoladi. Agar biznes uchun ruxsat etilgan RPO = 2 soat bo'lsa, bu qoida buzilgan hisoblanadi.
why_right_en: Correct answer: «The maximum acceptable data loss measured backwards in time from a disaster».

why_wrongs.B: Noto'g'ri: 'Serverni ta'mirlash uchun ketadigan soatlar soni' ushbu savol shartiga mos kelmaydi yoki boshqa tushunchaga tegishli.

why_wrongs.D: Noto'g'ri: 'Kompaniya ishchilarining tushlik vaqti' ushbu savol shartiga mos kelmaydi yoki boshqa tushunchaga tegishli.

question_uz: Kiberxavfsizlikda zaxira nusxalashning mashhur '3-2-1 zaxiralash qoidasi' qanday talablarni o'z ichiga oladi?
question_en: What are the specific operational requirements of the industry-standard '3-2-1 Backup Rule'?
options_uz: 3 ta xodim 2 ta parolni 1 kunda almashtirishi
Ma'lumotlarning 3 ta nusxasi bo'lishi, ular kamida 2 xil turdagi saqlash vositalarida (masalan disk va lenta/bulut) saqlanishi va 1 ta nusxa tashqarida (off-site / boshqa binoda) joylashishi shart
options_en: Backing up 1 file twice every 3 days
3 total copies of data, across 2 different media types, with 1 copy stored off-site
hint: 3 ta nusxa, 2 xil tashuvchi, 1 tasi boshqa hududda (off-site).
why_right: 3-2-1 qoidasi ofisda yong'in, suv toshqini yoki Ransomware hujumi bo'lgan taqdirda ham boshqa binodagi yoki bulutdagi 1 ta nusxa orqali biznesni saqlab qolishni kafolatlaydi.
why_right_en: Correct answer: «3 total copies of data, across 2 different media types, with 1 copy stored off-site».

why_wrongs.A: Noto'g'ri: '3 kunda 2 marta 1 ta faylni nusxalash' ushbu savol shartiga mos kelmaydi yoki boshqa tushunchaga tegishli.
why_wrongs.B: Noto'g'ri: '3 ta xodim 2 ta parolni 1 kunda almashtirishi' ushbu savol shartiga mos kelmaydi yoki boshqa tushunchaga tegishli.
why_wrongs.D: Noto'g'ri: 'Faqat 3 gigabayt joy ajratish' ushbu savol shartiga mos kelmaydi yoki boshqa tushunchaga tegishli.

question_uz: To'liq zaxira nusxasi (Full Backup) va Inkremental zaxira (Incremental Backup) o'rtasidagi asosiy farq nimada?
question_en: What is the key functional difference between a Full Backup and an Incremental Backup?
options_uz: To'liq zaxira faqat 1 ta faylni oladi
Inkremental zaxira har doim sekinroq ishlaydi
To'liq zaxira barcha ma'lumotlarni boshidan oxirigacha ko'chiradi; Inkremental zaxira esa faqat oxirgi zaxiralashdan keyin o'zgargan yoki yangi qo'shilgan fayllarnigina nusxalaydi
options_en: Full copies everything; Incremental copies only data modified since the last backup
hint: Har kuni hamma narsani qayta ko'chirish diskni to'ldirib yuboradi, shuning uchun faqat yangi o'zgarishlar (inkrement) olinadi.
why_right: Inkremental zaxiralash juda tez olinadi va diskda kam joy egallaydi, ammo tiklash paytida dastlabki Full backup va undan keyingi barcha inkrementlar ketma-ket qo'llanilishi kerak.
why_right_en: Correct answer: «Full copies everything; Incremental copies only data modified since the last backup».

options_uz: Oxirgi olingan TO'LIQ (Full) zaxira nusxasiga nisbatan yuz bergan barcha o'zgarishlarni nusxalaydi
options_en: All changes made since the last FULL backup
hint: Inkremental oxirgi har qanday backupga nisbatan olsa, Differensial har doim oxirgi Full backupga nisbatan to'planib boradi.
why_right: Differensial zaxiradan qayta tiklash osonroq (atigi 2 ta nusxa: 1 ta Full + 1 ta oxirgi Differensial kerak bo'ladi).
why_right_en: Correct answer: «All changes made since the last FULL backup».

question_uz: Virtual mashina yoki saqlash tizimlaridagi 'Snapshot' (Lohaziy tasvir) va an'anaviy 'Backup' (Zaxira nusxa) o'rtasidagi muhim farq nima?
question_en: What critical distinction separates a storage 'Snapshot' from a true 'Backup'?
options_uz: Snapshot — bu tizimning ma'lum bir daqiqadagi holatini tezkor qayd etish bo'lib, odatda o'sha saqlash massivining o'zida turadi; Haqiqiy Backup esa mustaqil boshqa jismoniy qurilmaga yoki joyga ko'chirilgan to'liq nusxadir
options_en: A snapshot is a quick state point-in-time dependent on host storage; a backup is an independent copy on separate media
hint: Agar asosiy disk fizik jihatdan yonsa, uning ichidagi barcha snapshotlar ham yo'q bo'ladi. Haqiqiy backup boshqa serverda turadi.
why_right: Snapshot dasturiy yangilanishlar oldidan tezda orqaga qaytish (rollback) uchun a'lo vosita, lekin u to'laqonli falokatdan saqlash (disaster recovery) o'rnini bosa olmaydi.
why_right_en: Correct answer: «A snapshot is a quick state point-in-time dependent on host storage; a backup is an independent copy on separate media».

question_en: Why is configuring 'Immutable' (Write Once, Read Many - WORM) backups vital against modern Ransomware?

why_right: Immutable backup tashkilotga to'lov (tovon) to'lamasdan o'z ma'lumotlarini 100% tiklab olish imkonini beruvchi yagona kafolatdir.
why_right_en: Correct answer: «Immutable backups cannot be overwritten, encrypted, or deleted by attackers or ransomware».

VM larning har biri o'zining to'liq alohida Mehmon Operatsion Tizimiga (Guest OS) ega bo'ladi; Konteynerlar esa xost operatsion tizimi yadrosini (Host OS Kernel) o'zaro birgalikda bo'lishadi

why_right: Konteynerlar soniyaning ulushlarida ishga tushadi va resurslarni kam sarflaydi; VM lar esa chuqurroq izolyatsiya ta'minlaydi.
why_right_en: Correct answer: «VMs run a full independent Guest OS; containers share the host operating system kernel».

question_en: How do modern EDR (Endpoint Detection and Response) agents supersede traditional legacy antivirus?
options_uz: Oddiy antivirus faqat ma'lum virus imzolarini (signatura) fayllardan qidiradi; EDR esa kompyuter xotirasi, jarayonlar va xatti-harakatlarni real vaqtda kuzatib, anomaliyalarga qarshi javob beradi
options_en: Antivirus relies on known file signatures; EDR continuously monitors behavioral anomalies, memory, and telemetry
hint: EDR — oxirgi qurilmadagi qora quti (black box) kabi: u har bir buyruq, PowerShell skripti va jarayonlar harakatini yozib boradi.
why_right: EDR (masalan, CrowdStrike Falcon, SentinelOne, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint) zero-day hujumlar va xotirada yashovchi (fileless) malware larni ham fosh eta oladi.
why_right_en: Correct answer: «Antivirus relies on known file signatures; EDR continuously monitors behavioral anomalies, memory, and telemetry».

question_en: What is the operational rule of Application Whitelisting on secure endpoints?
options_uz: Barcha dasturlarni erkin o'rnatishga ruxsat berish
Tizimda faqat oldindan administrator tomonidan ruxsat berilgan 'Oq ro'yxatdagi' dasturlargina ishga tushishi mumkin; boshqa barcha yangi dasturlar va viruslar sukut bo'yicha bloklanadi
Faqat oq rangdagi ikonkalarga ega dasturlarni ishlatish
options_en: Allowing all apps to run freely
Only explicitly approved applications on an allow-list are permitted to execute; everything else is blocked by default
hint: Qora ro'yxat yomonlarni bloklasa, Oq ro'yxat faqat ma'lum yaxshi dasturlarga ruxsat beradi.
why_right: Application Whitelisting (masalan, Windows AppLocker) nolinchi kun (zero-day) viruslariga qarshi eng samarali vositadir, chunki begona fayl baribir ishga tushmaydi.
why_right_en: Correct answer: «Only explicitly approved applications on an allow-list are permitted to execute; everything else is blocked by default».

question_uz: Kiberxavfsizlik amaliyotida Endpoint himoyasida eng zaif bo'g'in har doim kim yoki nima hisoblanadi?
question_en: In enterprise cybersecurity operations, what is universally acknowledged as the most vulnerable component of endpoint security?
options_uz: Inson omili (Xodimlar / Foydalanuvchilarning e'tiborsizligi va kiber-savodsizligi)
options_en: The human factor (employee negligence and lack of security awareness)
hint: Eng kuchli firewall ham xodim o'z qo'li bilan fishing havolasiga parolini yozib bersa yordam bera olmaydi.
